Stop reading code blind! Meet the Understand-Anything

Understand-Anything is an open source plugin that transforms a code base into an interactive graph, meaning each part and guided tours. The video shows the legacy code problem, as the tool combines deterministic analysis and language models, use cases and cost in tokens.

Published in 26 May 2026 · 6 min 59 s

  • Agentic engineering

Open on YouTube

The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets lead to the stretch of the video.

  1. The problem of legacy code

The problem of legacy code

Who joins a new team and opens a legacy project finds 200,000 lines of code and doesn't know where to start 00:21.

Causes are known 01:02:

  • the outdated documentation 01:22;
  • the engineers who knew the project and already left 01:22;
  • AI agents hallucinating because they don't have the context of architecture and look at few loose files 01:22.

What is Understand-Anything

The Understand-Anything was born as a plugin for Claude Code, and the community adapted it to Cursor, Copilot and Gemini CLI 01:43. It passes the project through an AI agent pipeline and generates an interactive and searchable knowledge graph 02:05. Instead of reading file by file, you click, search and ask questions about architecture 02:05.

Meaning, not just structure

Ancient tool graphs show a tangle of files and lines without context 02:25. Understand-Anything shows business logic: instead of saying the file The matter the B, says that both are part of the stream of authentication or payment 02:47.

  • Impact analysis: shows the effect of a change before commit 03:08.
  • Public interface: less detail for product, more depth for those who program 03:08.
  • Layers: nodes are grouped by layer of architecture 03:08.
  • Guided tours: automatic tutorials that teach system flow step by step 03:08.

To use, install the plugin, run the analysis, open the panel in the browser and read the natural language abstracts of each function and file 03:28.

How it works underneath

The tool doesn't use LLM for everything. The deterministic tree-sitter extracts raw facts such as imports and calls 03:49. Language models take this structure and write abstracts, identify business domains and create tutorials 04:10.

The pipeline runs up to six agents at the same time: one for the frameworks, one for the functions, one for the layers, one for the scripts, one for the business rules and one that revises the graph so as not to leave loose references 04:30.

Use cases

  • Onboarding: the new person receives the map and guided tour, instead of old documentation 05:11.
  • Context for agents: with the map, AI code suggestions improve 05:11.
  • Refactoring: impact analysis shows what will break before saving 05:11.

According to the video, the project passed 33,500 stars in GitHub in a short time. 05:31.

The cost

The tool is free and open source, but spends many tokens: several agents analyze and summarize all files 05:53. According to the video, it takes a heavy plan, like Claude Max. 06:14. The exchange is to spend computing to save dozens or hundreds of hours of work 06:14.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does Understand-Anything get paid?

The tool is free and open source, but calls to AI models are expensive 06:14.

Does it only work with Claude Code?

Nope. Born for Claude Code, but already runs with Cursor, Copilot and Gemini CLI 01:43.

Reviewed by Maurício Yokoyama Issei in 16 November 2026.

About the video

Have you ever entered a new project with 200,000 lines of code and felt lost?
. Understand-Anything is the ultimate solution to master any complex code base in minutes, turning it into an interactive knowledge graph that really teaches you
.
Unlike tools that show only a tangle of files, Understand-Anything focuses on meaning, mapping business flows, architectural layers and dependencies in a visual and intuitive way
.
What will you see in this video:
Guided Tours: Automatic Walkthroughs that teach architecture in the right order
.
Domain View: Understand how code translates into real business processes (e.g. payment flows, authentication)
.
Semantic Search and Fuzzy: Find what you need by name or meaning of functionality
.
Impact Analysis (Diff): See which parts of the system your changes may affect even before committing
.
Total Compatibility: The tool works perfectly with the leading AI players in the market: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Codex and many others
.
Official Links:
Repository on GitHub: https://github.com/Lum1104/Understand-Anything
Official website and Live Demo: https://understand-anything.com

No more weeks onboarding. Start seeing the "Big Picture" of your software today!
.
